nodes.description: Read raw clinical notes from a JSONL file into the main record stream.
Remove the 'text' field from the records to simplify the data structure.
Generate the 'output' field with patient-friendly instructions from the clinical notes.
Evaluate the quality of the generated 'output' field against a quality rubric.
Validate that the format of the 'output' field meets the required standards.
Write the processed records with populated 'output' field back to a JSONL file.

optimization_blueprint.global_optimization_direction: Transform the empty 'output' field in raw clinical notes into a populated, patient-friendly output that provides clear medical instructions, ensuring clarity and safety in communication.
key_improvements: Populate the 'output' field with detailed, patient-friendly instructions derived from clinical notes.
Remove the 'text' field from the schema to simplify the data structure and focus on essential outputs.
Ensure that the output adheres to medical accuracy and is easily understandable by patients.
transformation_strategies: Implement a process to analyze clinical notes and generate clear, patient-friendly language for the 'output' field.
Utilize natural language processing techniques to enhance the clarity and readability of the output instructions.
Establish guidelines for ensuring that the output meets quality standards for patient education.
quality_focus: Ensure that the 'output' field is populated with medically accurate information.
Focus on using plain language that is accessible to patients, avoiding clinical jargon.
Incorporate safety reminders and clear instructions in the output to enhance patient understanding.
optimization_blueprint.summary: The optimization blueprint outlines the need to transform the raw clinical notes by populating the 'output' field with clear, patient-friendly instructions. Key improvements include simplifying the schema by removing unnecessary fields and ensuring that the output meets high standards of medical accuracy and clarity. The transformation strategies emphasize the use of natural language processing to enhance the quality of the output, ultimately aiming to improve patient education and safety.

template_selection.selection_rationale: These templates were selected because they directly address the transformation goals outlined in the optimization blueprint. 'content_enhancement' will ensure that the output field is populated with detailed, patient-friendly instructions. 'structure_optimization' will help simplify the data structure by removing unnecessary fields. 'field_extraction' will assist in extracting relevant information from clinical notes, and 'quality_validation' will ensure that the output adheres to medical accuracy and clarity.
